# Research report 1 of 2

# Research brief: will Anthropic release "Claude Opus 5.2" in September 2026?

I found no official sign of a model called Claude Opus 5.2 on or before 2026-09-18. The name appears only in community leak rumors and low-quality aggregator posts. I left out everything published after 2026-09-18.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question links five X/Twitter posts (Token Gremlin, Chetaslua, Vidhi, Pradeep Kapoor, Just a dragon). It gives no URLs, so I couldn't open them. The practical deciding source is Anthropic's official newsroom or model release notes.
- Through 2026-09-18: Anthropic's newsroom has no entry for "Opus 5.2" dated on or before that day. The most recent model entry there in September is Claude Mythos and Fable 5.1. [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. As of 2026-09-18 Anthropic had not announced Opus 5.2, and I found no model ID, price or release date for it. The newest confirmed Opus is still Opus 5.
- The name is a real risk for this question: "Opus 5.2" is a label the community made up for a build it believes is being tested. Anthropic has never used that name. If Anthropic ships the next Opus under a different number, such as a jump to 5.5, the question resolves NO even though "a new Opus" came out. The question says Opus 5.1 and Sonnet 5.2 don't count.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-17 (reported): The unannounced build that people called "Opus 5.2" was reportedly being served to some traffic under the normal "Opus 5" label. Reports say it was briefly switched off on the night of September 17. [CometAPI](https://www.cometapi.com/da/claude-opus-5-2-coming-soon/)
- Mid-September 2026: Some developers claimed a backend model name pointing to Opus 5.2, with faster output. A Baidu Baike entry calls this "canary testing" (a small trial rollout). Other aggregators say no identifier or traffic evidence exists, so the reports conflict. [Baidu Baike](https://baike.baidu.com/en/item/Claude%20Opus%205.2/5951020), [cellcog Opus 5.1 page](https://cellcog.ai/blog/claude-opus-5-1-release-date/), [BigGo](https://finance.biggo.com/news/5e2dd4ec-ae57-4758-a9dd-ce9a715bb58c)
- 2026-09-15 (claimed): kie.ai says Opus 5.2 "launched" on September 15 in Claude Code, Chat and Cowork. The same page admits that pricing, context limits and benchmarks are unconfirmed, and no Anthropic source backs it. Treat it as unreliable. [kie.ai](https://kie.ai/blog/what-is-claude-opus-5-2)
- 2026-09-14: The rumor appears to start here, with an X account claiming Claude Code was sending Opus 5 requests to an "Opus 5.2" build. [cellcog](https://cellcog.ai/blog/claude-opus-5-2-release-date/)
- 2026-09-01 / 09-15: Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 were released. Most sources say Sept 1, but Anthropic's newsroom lists Sept 15. Either way, Anthropic is doing ".1" point releases on other model lines. [SD Times](https://sdtimes.com/tag/mythos-5-1/), [LLM Gateway](https://llmgateway.io/models/claude-fable-5-1)
- 2026-07-24: Claude Opus 5 was released (same price as Opus 4.8). [Verdict](https://www.verdict.co.uk/?p=402971), [Proactive Investors](https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1097550/traders-bet-anthropic-will-ship-next-frontier-model-within-weeks-1097550.html)

## 4. Base rates
- Recent Opus releases: Opus 4.8, then Opus 5 on 2026-07-24. Late September would be about 2 months after Opus 5, which fits Anthropic's recent pace of roughly 2 to 3 months between releases.
- Naming: Anthropic has used x.1 steps (Opus 4.1, Fable/Mythos 5.1) and has sometimes skipped numbers. A version number that only exists in rumors has often not matched the eventual official name. I found no Anthropic model ever called "x.2" in the Opus 5 line.
- An Opus 5.1 was never released, so "5.2" would mean skipping 5.1. That is possible but unusual. [OrcaRouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/blog/claude-opus-5-1)

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-25: Polymarket priced a Mythos-class release by Sept 15 at 81% and by Sept 30 at 87%. It priced a new Opus by Dec 31 at 96%. These markets are about any release, not the name "5.2". [Proactive Investors](https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1097550/traders-bet-anthropic-will-ship-next-frontier-model-within-weeks-1097550.html)
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market that specifically resolves on the name "Opus 5.2".

- Anthropic's newsroom and model-deprecation pages will show the official name. For this question the name matters more than the timing.

# Opus 5.2 release in September 2026: research brief (as of 2026-09-18)

## 1. Resolution source
- The question gives no URL. The links are only X posts from hype accounts (@TokenGremlin, @chetaslua, @vidhiparmarr, @pradeepXkapoor, @Waguri_Kaoruko8). In practice it resolves on whether Anthropic officially releases a model named exactly "Claude Opus 5.2" by 2026-09-30. Opus 5.1 and Sonnet 5.2 do not count.
- 2026-09-18: Searches found no Anthropic announcement, news post or docs entry for "Opus 5.2". A Baidu Baike page titled "Claude Opus 5.2 (A model released by Anthropic in September 2026)" is user-edited and cites a canary test, not a launch. [Baidu Baike](https://baike.baidu.com/en/item/Claude%20Opus%205.2/5951020)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. No model named Opus 5.2 is officially out. The evidence so far is unverified routing and canary claims.
- The current public Opus is Opus 5, released 2026-07-24. Its price is $5/$25 per million input/output tokens. [Vercel AI Gateway](https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/claude-opus-5/about), [CometAPI](https://www.cometapi.com/claude-opus-5-1/)
- The rumored Opus 5.1 never shipped either. Leaked test strings never contained the name, and rumored dates of Aug 28, Aug 31 and Sep 5 all passed without a release. [CellCog on Opus 5.1](https://cellcog.ai/blog/claude-opus-5-1-release-date/), [OrcaRouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-1-opus-5-1-delay-leak)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-09-17: One report says the suspected Opus 5.2 routing in Claude Code was shut off on the night of Sept 17. [OrcaRouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/blog/claude-opus-5-5-leak)
- About 2026-09-15 to 09-17: BigGo reports a "stealth" gray-release rollout. Developers allegedly saw a backend model ID pointing to Opus 5.2 while the interface still said Opus 5. [BigGo Finance](https://finance.biggo.com/news/5e2dd4ec-ae57-4758-a9dd-ce9a715bb58c), [CometAPI](https://www.cometapi.com/claude-opus-5-2-coming-soon/)

- 2026-09-14, 12:15 UTC: The rumor seems to start with one X post, from @notjazii: "opus 5 is confirmed routing opus 5.2". It was based on one prompt answering differently in Claude Code and Devin. About a dozen accounts reposted it without adding evidence. Explainers note there is no changelog, no status-page note and no Anthropic employee confirmation. [explainx](https://explainx.ai/blog/opus-5-2-stealth-routing-rumor-claude-code-september-2026), [Medium, The AI Brief](https://medium.com/the-ai-brief/fable-5-2-and-opus-5-2-leaks-anthropic-needs-to-catch-up-e750df0b82e7)

[technews.tw](https://technews.tw/2026/09/02/anthropic-launches-fable-5-1/), [smol.ai](https://news.smol.ai/issues/26-09-01-claude-mythos-51/), [MacG](https://www.macg.co/intelligence-artificielle/2026/09/anthropic-lance-fable-51-presente-comme-plus-performant-et-moins-cher-que-son-predecesseur-310791)

## 4. Base rates
- Recent Opus releases, as reported:
  - Opus 4.1: Aug 2025 [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-08-05/anthropic-unveils-more-powerful-model-ahead-of-gpt-5-release)
  - Opus 4.5: 2025-11-24 [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/11/24/anthropic-releases-opus-4-5-with-new-chrome-and-excel-integrations/embed/)
  - Opus 4.8: about 2026-05-28
  - Opus 5: 2026-07-24
- That is a gap of about 2 months between recent Opus releases. By late September, Opus 5 will be about 2 months old, so a new Opus this month fits the pattern.
- The naming is the bigger risk. Anthropic has skipped version numbers before (4.1 went to 4.5). It has also not released an "Opus 5.1", so the next Opus could carry a different number. The question only counts the exact name "Opus 5.2". Community version guesses (Opus 5.1 in August) have often been wrong.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Early Sept 2026: Polymarket's "next Claude Opus released by September 30, 2026" market was reportedly at **82%**. [Apnipathshala on X](https://x.com/apnipathshalain/status/2096857377765208126), [Polymarket "by" market](https://polymarket.com/event/next-claude-opus-released-byptptpt-20260727142323912)
- That market counts **any** model officially named Opus, not specifically "Opus 5.2". It is therefore a ceiling for this question, not a direct estimate.
- Polymarket also has a "released on..." date market for late September, created around 2026-09-15. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/next-claude-opus-released-onptptpt-20260915/will-the-next-claude-opus-model-be-released-on-september-25-2026)

- I found no Manifold or Kalshi market specifically on the name "Opus 5.2".

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- An Anthropic launch could come any weekday before 2026-09-30. Anthropic often launches on Tuesdays or Thursdays.
- Watch for new model IDs showing up on Bedrock, Vertex or OpenRouter. These have leaked releases before; for example, Bedrock 404s hinted at Fable 5.1. [OrcaRouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-1-opus-5-1-delay-leak)
- The key uncertainty is the name: even if a new Opus ships in September, it would have to be called exactly "Opus 5.2".
- Caveat: several of the pages above wouldn't load through the proxy, so their dates and details come from search snippets only.
